delete.description:
Deletes the account, its Pessoal and the organizations where it is the only Owner, whose members are told;
pages it wrote in other bases stay. 403 `reauthentication_required` without a recent sign-in.

post.description:
Sends a code to the new address; the email changes only on `POST /v1/account/email/confirm`. 403
`reauthentication_required` without a recent sign-in.
The code sent to the new address changes the email; the old address is told.

put.description:
Sets or changes the password and ends every other session; 403 `reauthentication_required` without a
recent sign-in.
A PNG, JPEG or WebP of at most 2 MB; its centered square, 256 px, becomes the photo.

get.description: Any account's photo, for any signed-in person.

Where Google returns. Signs in or up and opens `next`; opens `/entrar/vincular?token=` when the account with
that email must confirm its password first; any failure opens `/entrar?erro=google`.

delete.description:
Desvincular Google. 403 `reauthentication_required` without a recent sign-in; 409 `last_way_in` when the
account has no password and no passkey.

post.description:
Links Google to the account of `token` (10 minutes) after its password, and signs in.

A wrong password is 401 `invalid_credentials`; an expired or already linked token is 422 `code_invalid`.

get.description:
Sends the browser to Google; after it, the web app opens `next` when it is a path of its own, else `/`.
`timezone` is the browser's IANA time zone, kept by an account Google signs up (unknown: America/Sao_Paulo).

post.description: A new code, the old one no longer valid; 204 also when the email has no account.
A single-use link valid for an hour goes to the email; 204 also when the email has no account.
Sets the password, ends every session of the account and signs in.
Turns the toggle of the same link back on.

Signs in; with two-step verification on, sends the code and answers `PendingSignIn` instead, with a pending
cookie for `POST /v1/auth/two-factor`.

schema.title: Response Sign In V1 Auth Sign In Post

post.description: An unconfirmed account; a 6-digit code goes to the email.
The code of the pending sign-in signs in; `code_invalid` once wrong, expired or out of tries.
A new code for the pending sign-in, at most once a minute; `channel: email` sends it by email.

Parar de receber: turns off the toggle the emailed link carries, without signing in; any body, so the
RFC 8058 one-click POST works too. 404 `not_found` for a bad link or a deleted account.
Confirms the email with its code and signs in.

put.description: Adds a page or folder to the favorites, last or just before `before_id`; a favorite already there moves.

get.description: The person's organizations: Pessoal first, then by name.

schema.title: Response List Organizations V1 Organizations Get

post.description: The creator becomes its Owner.

delete.description:
Owners only, with a recent sign-in (403 `reauthentication_required`); a Pessoal goes only with its account
(403 `personal_org`). Its bases go with every page, file and version, never through the trash; every other
member is told by email.

patch.description:
Owners and Admins; a Pessoal keeps its name and requires nothing. Turning `require_two_factor` on emails the
members who sign in with a password only; `password_only` says how many remain.

get.description: Organização › Auditoria, for Owners and Admins: the last 90 days, newest first.

schema.title: Response Audit V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Audit Get

get.description: The audit of `GET /audit` as a CSV download (Exportar CSV).
Invites not yet accepted nor revoked, expired ones included.

schema.title: Response Organization Invites V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Invites Get

post.description: Emails each address a 7-day link; 409 `already_member` names the emails already in the organization.

schema.title: Response Invite To Organization V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Invites Post

post.description: Any member but the last Owner (409 `last_owner`); a Pessoal cannot be left (403).

put.description: A PNG, JPEG or WebP of at most 2 MB; its centered square, 256 px, becomes the logo.

get.description: Owners and Admins; a Pessoal has none (403).

schema.title: Response List Members V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Members Get

delete.description: Takes the member and their access to the organization's bases out; they are told by email.

patch.description:
Owners change any role, Admins those below Owner; the last Owner stays (409 `last_owner`). The member is
told by email.

post.description: Any file of at most 100 MB put in the page, outside the tree; over it is 422 `attachment_too_large`.
A link to the attachment's bytes that opens without the cookie for 60 seconds.

get.description:
The attachment byte for byte; one `Range` of bytes is honored.

Takes the session cookie or a link from `POST /v1/pages/{node_id}/attachments/{name}/link`.

416.description: The range is outside the file.

put.description: The person follows the page, for the daily digest; following it again changes nothing.

post.description: The person left the page: the working text becomes a version, unless it already is one.

get.description: The pages of the base with a `[[…]]` link to this one, ordered by path, each with the line holding it.

schema.title: Response List Page Mentions V1 Pages  Node Id  Mentions Get

put.description:
Autosave of the working text. A 409 `stale_page` carries the newest `markdown` and `revision` in `details`;
the refused text was kept as a version.

get.description: The page's versions, newest first, without their text; the working text is cut as a version first.

schema.title: Response List Page Versions V1 Pages  Node Id  Versions Get

get.description: The account's passkeys, oldest first.

schema.title: Response List Passkeys V1 Passkeys Get

post.description:
Adds the passkey the browser created. An expired prompt or a credential that does not verify is 422
`code_invalid`.

Creation options for `navigator.credentials.create()`; the challenge rides a 5-minute cookie. Without a recent
sign-in it is 403 `reauthentication_required`.

Signs in with a passkey, no second step. On a live session it confirms it instead (a recent sign-in for
sensitive changes), and a passkey of another account is 401 `invalid_credentials`, like one that does not
verify; an expired prompt is 422 `code_invalid`.

Request options for `navigator.credentials.get()`, with no allowed credentials so the browser offers any
passkey of the site (also as autofill); the challenge rides a 5-minute cookie.

delete.description:
Removes a passkey. Without a recent sign-in it is 403 `reauthentication_required`; the only way in of an
account with no password and no Google is 409 `last_way_in`.

get.description: Conta › Atividade: the account's last 90 days, newest first.

schema.title: Response Activity V1 Security Activity Get

get.description: What Conta › Segurança and "2FA exigido" may offer.
Every open session of the account, the last used first.

schema.title: Response List Sessions V1 Sessions Get

post.description: Sair de todas as outras: every session but this one ends.

The password again lets this session make sensitive changes for 10 minutes.

A wrong password is 401 `invalid_credentials` and counts toward the sign-in lockout (429).

delete.description: Ends another session of the account; the current one is 422 (it ends by signing out).
Turns two-step verification off; needs a recent sign-in.

post.description:
Email turns on at once; WhatsApp sends a code to `phone`, and turns on at `POST /v1/two-factor/confirm`.
WhatsApp needs a recent sign-in (403 `reauthentication_required`), and is 422 `validation` when this server
sends no WhatsApp.
The WhatsApp code confirms the number and turns WhatsApp on in place of email.
